initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite sheet for a side-view 2D fighting game. Create ROOK, a balanced blue-armored sword fighter, royal blue armor with pale gold trim, silver sword, readable face and compact athletic build. Crisp 16-bit pixel art, bold dark outlines, limited palette, coherent proportions. EXACT square atlas layout: 4 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells, no margins between cells. Eight full-body poses facing RIGHT, each centered inside its own cell with generous transparent padding so weapons never cross cell boundaries. Top row left to right: idle guard with sword, walking stride, raised defensive sword block, airborne jump. Bottom row: light sword thrust, heavy sword slash, magical gold sword special attack, recoiling hurt pose. Feet aligned at same baseline within every cell except jump. Same character size and costume in every pose. Actual transparent alpha background, no shadow on ground, no grid, no text, no letters, no borders, no UI. Entire body and sword visible in each cell. Canvas 1024 by 1024.
